rows.text: The PMO media release of 31 December 2014 says that the Prime Minister-elect 'has recommended to His Majesty King Tupou VI' the appointment of the ministers of the new Government, which 'will be effective as of 31st December, 2014'.
rows.uncertainty: The recommendation and the effective day it forecast (the sentence is garbled as printed). No royal act or its day is stated, so 31 December 2014 is not used as a start, just as the 2017 revocation recommendation is not used as an end. IPU's record that the Cabinet took office on 19 January 2015 (to_ipu_2014_cabinet_took_office_20150119) conflicts; IPU is corroboration only and is not cited here. The 'Parliamentary term 2015-2018' it names is not an end.

rows.text: The same release lists the members of the new Cabinet, the second being 'Hon. Siaosi'Ofakivahafolau Sovaleni- Deputy Prime Minister' with the environment, energy, climate change, disaster management, meteorology, information and communications portfolios.
rows.uncertainty: The release's list styles him Deputy Prime Minister on its date, which dates the holder observation; it is not a start. The other ministers are not imported.
